messages:
alex_marketing: quick flag for the team 1: were seeing weekend spike in unassigned webinar leads. looks like enrichment retries + geo-rr logic causing them to sit unowned for >5m. want a short mitigation plan we can ship today.

sara_salesops: saw this too. pattern: hubspot returns 202 (delayed enrichment) -> our webhook retries -> rr attempts assignment into wrong timezone pool -> claim fails, retries loop.

tom_eng: can we add a backoff on webhook retries and a temporary TTL that keeps lead pinned to the first claim attempt for 3 minutes? that should stop the churn.

ben_sdr: when leads sit unassigned they go cold. can we also email SDR inbox with a digest for any lead unassigned >2m over weekend? small manual safety net.

hubspot-integration: note: HubSpot sometimes batches events during low traffic windows and sends multiple duplicates. recommend idempotent write handling using eventId + externalId. also sign webhooks to verify origin.

qa-bot: suggestion: add a canary rule that only applies to weekend windows (Fri 18:00 -> Mon 08:00 UTC) so normal weekday flow unchanged. deploy canary to 10% of requests first.

sara_salesops: plan proposal (minimal):
- if webhook returns 202, set LEAD_STATE=ENRICH_PENDING and set pinned=true for 180s.
- RR: if pinned=true, don't reassign to other timezone pools, allow one retry only.
- webhook client: use exponential backoff with jitter (base 3s, max 60s) and dedupe by eventId.
- alert: if unassigned_count > 10 for 10m in weekend window -> page oncall.

tom_eng: engineering tasks i can take today:
- add pinned flag + 180s TTL (PR)
- implement retry backoff in webhook consumer (PR)
- add metric lead_pinned_count and weekend_unassigned_rate for dashboard (PR)

alex_marketing: operations/tasks for marketing/salesops:
- ben: prepare SDR digest email template and cadence for weekend leads >2m unassigned
- sara: update handoff playbook + add a short runbook for oncall with exact logs to check (rr.claim_id, webhook.eventId)

ben_sdr: i'll set up a shared inbox and a simple Zapier rule to notify if push from API indicates unassigned lead >2m. good short-term fix.

oncall: adding escalation note: if page fires twice within 30m, escalate to engineering lead on-call and then to ops director.

hubspot-integration: webhook safety snippet for docs:
```
POST /hooks/hubspot
Headers: X-HubSpot-Signature: sha256=...
Body: {"eventId":"evt_123","externalId":"lead_456","payload": {...}}
Server behavior:
- verify signature
- check eventId dedupe table, ignore duplicates
- if enrichment required -> respond 202 and set LEAD_STATE=ENRICH_PENDING
- if processed -> respond 200
```

tom_eng: deploying to staging now for the pinned flag and backoff. will open PR links when ready.

sara_salesops: can we also schedule a smoke test for Monday morning to check that timezone routing is healthy? if not, rollback the weekend canary.

alex_marketing: yes. schedule smoke at 08:15 UTC Mon and lock a rollback window 08:15-09:00.

qa-bot: staging deploy passed quick integration tests; canary toggle ready.

ben_sdr: digest template drafted and shared in the doc. will pilot this weekend.

alex_marketing: thanks everyone. shipping minimal config today and monitoring closely. we'll reconvene Monday with metrics (unassigned_count, time_to_assign median) and decide on permanent changes. :rocket:
